missing_explained.why: not in a section for this award; printed only under Ford Essentials (CERT)

notes: The page's only program section is 'Automotive Technology: Ford Essentials (CERT)', formerly known as 'Automotive Technology: Automotive Heavy Line and Chassis Technician'. It does not match the named award, 'Automotive Technology: Automotive Electrical & Engine Performance Technician'.
The text has no section for the named award, so no blocks, total or outcomes were recorded for it. A reviewer should find the correct catalog page for this program.

For reference, the Ford Essentials section requires AUTO 151 (5.0), AUTO 161 (5.0), AUTO 111 (4.0) and AUTO 173 (6.0; 'Course must be taken twice for 2 units'), with Total Units 20. It lists three program student learning outcomes. None of this was recorded, because it belongs to a different award.
